401-1829-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1829-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7728.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2292-2393-2738-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

348-1152-1417-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-1417-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Bridge from Below triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

5086-5183-5231-6441-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6441-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

413-7124-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7278.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Slash trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-2968-3231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-2968-3231.description:
Cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W} total, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-2968-3231.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{U}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-5900-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

2512-3588-4594.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1170-1329-2079-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

522-2111-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1852-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
1852-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-6556.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
5078-5243-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

338-3197-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-6458.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2793-3743-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
392-2793-3743-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

645-1267-2438-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2438-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

2061-2103-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-4125.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-3263-4853-5231--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-5231--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

4030-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4030-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

832-1371-1860-3765.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Thoughtseize by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Thoughtseize.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Thoughtseize, causing them to lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining opponent.

69-391-539-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Blossom Dryad do not have summoning sickness.
69-391-539-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-391-539-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

154-1331-2557-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Fierce Witchstalker.
You control at least two Foods.
154-1331-2557-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Fierce Witchstalker to deal six damage to itself.
Fierce Witchstalker dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Fierce Witchstalker from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Fierce Witchstalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

1651-2382-4131-4840.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

2557-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
2557-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing both Spawns.
The Spawns die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3126-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Paruns attached to Marrow-Gnawer.
Marrow-Gnawer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three additional Rats.
2034-3126-5200.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat, creating at least three 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Rat tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Marrow-Gnawer.
Repeat.
